selection: Freeze the lowest stored validation best_score among terminal matched candidates with full prepared point-source coverage; no acceptance-based candidate replacement.
scope: Original labelled10-vertex tree and original endpoint holdout. Existing protected known-endpoint relations are a regression gate; fresh unseen-source and both-unseen queries exclude every old evaluation pair and balance exact distance layers. All held endpoint loss-input exposure must be zero. Each cohort and each fresh21+ subset must meet its completion gate independently. Known five difficult questions are retained as a separate regression gate. No oracle features, search, successor pruning or LLM evaluation.
